courses.title: People Management for New Managers
courses.description: People Management for New Managers focuses on people management for people working toward a People Manager role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces teamwork, enough to apply alongside people management in real People Manager work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to people management and show how teamwork supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying people management to a real People Manager scenario
Practicing people management through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to teamwork
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Clinical Data Standards in Practice
courses.description: Clinical Data Standards in Practice goes beyond the basics of clinical data standards, for people already working toward a People Manager role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in clinical data standards and want to go further.
